releases.name: Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor
releases.summary:
Sicily – Winter, 1905. In the months since his initiation, Enzo Favara has proven himself a reliable soldier of the Torrisi crime family. Now the Don entrusts him and Cesare with a delicate assignment: assist Ennio Salieri, a man of honor recently released from prison and intent on reclaiming what is his.

At Salieri's side, Enzo is drawn deeper into the volatile underworld of the Valle Dorata, where loyalty is tested, debts are settled, and every move carries weight.

Continue Enzo's story across two new chapters, featuring fresh environments, weapons, vehicles, and Charms. In new DLC content for Free Ride mode, team up with Salieri to earn big by taking on a new set of exclusive jobs and extreme challenges, and discover new collectibles and hidden locations as you explore.

releases.name: Mafia: The Omerta Collection
releases.summary: Mafia: The Omertà Collection, includes. Mafia: The Old Country Definitive Edition, Mafia: Definitive Edition, Mafia II: Definitive Edition, and Mafia III: Definitive Edition.

releases.name: Akatori
releases.summary:
Akatori is a metroidvania/slasher platformer with a charming pixel-art and a captivating story. You're going to follow the young girl Mako that starts a fascinating adventure to save her world from destruction.

Dive into magical worlds of Aarkalia, uncover its secrets and stop the ancient God awakening ritual.

releases.name: Tower Dominion
releases.summary:
Your empire faces relentless invasions from the savage Artronids, threatening its very existence. As Commander, you are the last line of defense against the deadly enemy onslaught.

Survival depends on constant innovation and adaptation. Every alien wave is a unique combination of Artronids that will test your ability to adapt.

Are you ready to employ innovative tactics, build impregnable defenses and hold the line? Commander, your troops await your orders!

releases.name: Grave Seasons
releases.summary:
Build your farm, fish and mine, and explore the unknowns of a strange, ancient town all while romancing the secretive local townsfolk. Just make sure you stop the supernatural murders before it’s too late… 

What happens when you blend an unnatural serial killer with a idyllic, isolated mountain town? 

You escaped jail and managed to make it to Ashenridge, but at what cost? Build your farm, fish and mine, and explore the unknowns of a strange, ancient town all while romancing the secretive local townsfolk. Just make sure you stop the supernatural murders before it’s too late… in GRAVE SEASONS, an all-new murder mystery farming sim RPG!

releases.name: Busy Bar - World Tour
releases.summary: Serve drinks, survive ridiculous guests, upgrade your bars, and buy out rival moguls — solo or in co-op — in a chill bar empire game where every shift ends in progress.

releases.name: Hit N Slash VR
releases.summary: Step into a mesmerizing abstract universe in hitNslash VR, a relaxing yet fast-paced action experience designed for virtual reality.Equipped with two unique weapons the Slasher and the Smasher you must react quickly as obstacles appear in your path. Slice through fragile objects, smash heavy blocks, and keep moving forward in an endless procedural world.Every run generates a new path filled with obstacles, pickups, and surprises across five visually distinct biomes. With chill electronic music, vibrant neon environments, and intuitive VR gameplay, HitNslash VR creates a satisfying rhythm of destruction and flow.Break through obstacles.Slice with precision.Survive as long as you can.How far can you go in the infinite world of hitNslash VR?

releases.name: Karakulo 21
releases.summary: You've been recruited by ChocoShit S.A. to pay off your debt in the "KK" Program. Open thousands of chocolate bars, feed the insatiable KaraKulo, and pray for the Golden Ticket that will earn your freedom. Upgrade, survive corporate exploitation, and keep working!

releases.name: Aether Keepers
releases.summary: Protect the core! Don't let the demons eat it! Welcome to this addictive incremental tower defense challenge. Build and upgrade your army in real-time to get stronger and stronger. Create your invincible legion—All units move out!

releases.name: Island Farmer
releases.summary: Arrange the farm islands and see your archipelago expand. Just swap the blocks of a 3D jigsaw puzzle.

releases.name: Cairn - On the Trail: Deep Water
releases.summary:
On the Trail is a series of free DLCs for the award winning survival climbing game Cairn. Set out on the ascent of a lifetime with pro-climber Aava: climb anywhere, plan your route carefully, and manage your resources to survive the unforgiving ascent of Mount Kami.

On the Trail brings climbers to new climbing locations and challenges. Find your route freely in the new spots, solve fresh climbing problems and explore iconic places as you follow the trail of a legendary climber.

On the Trail: Deep Water, the first of the series, brings you 3 new climbing spots, and introduces water soloing: you can now climb over water, without the consequences when falling!

releases.name: Tyrant's Realm
releases.summary: Tyrant's Realm is a roguelite action-adventure inspired by classic PS1 visuals. Explore procedurally generated dark fantasy worlds, battling through dangers that evolve with each run. Death is not the end, as the night is still young.

releases.name: Idle Immortal
releases.summary:
Build a Chinese fantasy sect, recruit disciples, and forge the ultimate squad for ascension! Are you ready to walk the path to immortality as a true Sect Master?

+ Idle Gameplay: Enjoy a relaxing idle experience designed to help you unwind. Even while you are away, your sect keeps battling, growing stronger, and moving closer to ascension. 

+ Squad Building: Recruit from 16 playable characters. Each character has unique talents, classes, and skills. Bring in the disciples you need and freely build your own squad. 

+ Character Growth: Each character can choose one of six different cultivation paths. They can also practice different cultivation techniques to gain unique bonuses. Even characters of the same class can grow into completely different builds. 

+ Explore the World: Journey across the land, discover other sects and factions, and advance the story. Gather resources for personal cultivation and sect development. Encounter random events and uncover unexpected treasures. 

+ Sect Management: While exploring the world, you will also manage your own sect. Earn reputation and sect resources to upgrade and expand your home base. Build different sect facilities to continuously produce useful items. A powerful sect will help you go further on the path to immortality.

releases.name: Plungeez
releases.summary:
Get ready for an introspective and challenging journey beneath the surface. Plungeez combines the classic exploration structure of a Metroidvania with the analytical depth of a pure puzzle game. Here, the environment is both your greatest adversary and your greatest reward. Unlike linear adventures, Plungeez requires you to observe, plan, and revisit familiar areas with fresh eyes.

Each mechanic you discover is a key to a new section of the map, transforming exploration into a constant stream of “eureka” moments. If you’re looking for an experience that respects your intelligence and rewards thorough curiosity, you’ve found your next destination.

Dive deep into this adventure set in the underground of the historic Brazilian city of Salvador, Bahia.

releases.name: Nightmare Shift
releases.summary: Take on night shifts at a remote motel, handle unsettling guests, and navigate eerie events. Experience Emma’s unnerving apartment life, feel the unease of being watched, and question what’s real as the line between reality and nightmare blurs.

releases.name: Bootstrap Island
releases.summary:
Bootstrap Island is an intense, realistic VR survival game, inspired by "Robinson Crusoe".

As the sole survivor of a 17th-century shipwreck you must quickly learn and adapt to survive against vicious beasts, explore the island and improve your skills to discover the mysteries of the tropical island.

releases.name: Emergency Room Simulator
releases.summary:
Step into the role of a doctor in a chaotic emergency room, where every second can mean the difference between life and death. Explore a richly detailed hospital environment with authentic medical equipment, from first response in the trauma bay to bedside patient care.

Visual exams, CT scans, X-rays, ultrasounds, ECGs, blood tests - run the right tests to confirm your suspicions. Listen to the paramedic's briefing, question and examine your patients, and ask the right questions.

Treat your patients with the right tools: administer medication, stitch up wounds, or apply bandages. Every treatment follows real medical procedures.

When things get serious, every second counts. Master time-critical emergencies like CPR and save lives when there's no time to hesitate.

releases.name: Panzer Knights: Commander's Edition
releases.summary:
Take command of a German panzer platoon and lead your forces through the chaos of World War II in this gripping tank simulation that blends hardcore strategy with anime-inspired visuals. Engage in explosive third-person combat across the battlefields of Europe, where every round counts. Load specialized ammunition, target enemy weak points, and call in tactical support as you adapt to the ever-changing situation on the front line.

Between missions, assemble an elite tank crew by handpicking recruits with unique skills, and deploy a formidable arsenal of meticulously detailed tanks, each with their own characteristics, strengths, and vulnerabilities.

In a conflict where victory is achieved through cunning, adaptability, and precision, do you have what it takes to emerge triumphant?

releases.name: Nightmare Delivery
releases.summary: Nightmare Delivery is a cooperative psychological horror game where players take the role of couriers sent into places no delivery should ever reach.You do not deliver to houses, streets, or real locations.You enter the distorted consciousness of different people and carry a package meant for the darkness hidden inside them.Each mission takes place inside a strange mental space shaped by fear, memory, guilt, obsession, or trauma. These places may look familiar at first, but their logic is broken. Corridors lead where they should not, rooms repeat without reason, and ordinary objects can become part of the puzzle.Play alone or in online co-op with up to 4 players. Explore unsettling locations, solve environmental puzzles, avoid dangerous entities, and work together to reach the final delivery point.The goal is not only to escape.The goal is to find what is hiding inside the mind, deliver the package, and survive long enough to return.Every level has its own atmosphere, rules, puzzles, and threats. Some creatures can be avoided. Others must be understood. Running is not always enough — sometimes survival depends on learning how the nightmare behaves.Complete the delivery.Calm the darkness.Get out alive.

releases.name: Omega Pilot Evolution
releases.summary:
Omega Pilot Evolution is a high-speed first-person VR racing experience that pushes the limits of futuristic flight. Take control of cutting-edge anti-gravity ships and master precision piloting across dynamic tracks designed for extreme speed and skill-based maneuvering.

Race solo or compete against real players in asynchronous and real-time multiplayer modes. Customize your ship's design and performance, dominate leaderboards, and unlock your legacy in the evolution of high-tech racing.

releases.name: Madden NFL 27
releases.summary: The next chapter of the legendary football game is coming soon with Madden NFL 27. Experience all-new gameplay, mode updates, and more as you step onto the gridiron and play for NFL glory.

releases.name: Touki Denshou: Angel Eyes
releases.summary:
"TOUKI DENSHOU ANGEL EYES" is a fighting game released by TECMO in 1996.

The player must win fierce battles against powerful opponents for the title of "Archangel".

You can use super special moves and special techniques to gain an advantage in battle when your emotional gauge reaches its peak.

releases.name: Pinball Action
releases.summary:
"PINBALL ACTION" is a pinball game released by TEHKAN (KOEI TECMO GAMES) in 1985.

Try to clear all the features on all four tables, switching between them over the game!

Use tricks to shake the tables, control the ball, and seize any chance at a win!

releases.name: CloverPit
releases.summary: A rogue-lite slot machine nightmare. Gamble for your life in a never-ending debt simulator!
